body:
# 🌿 Livia SMP 🌿

**Java 26.1.2 | Whitelist | Proximity Voice Chat | Vanilla Compatible**

A fresh world. A strong community. Your story starts here.

## 🌍 What is Livia?

Livia is a long-term, community-driven SMP focused on immersion, progression, and meaningful interaction.

This is not just another server reset. This is a world designed to grow over time with dedicated players who actually want to build something lasting.

✔ Active and established community  
✔ No empty world feeling on join  
✔ Built for long-term survival and progression  

## 🎤 Proximity Voice Chat

Livia uses proximity voice chat to make interactions feel natural and alive.

- Uses Plasmo Voice - required
- Fully vanilla compatible
- You can join without mods, but voice chat completes the experience

## ⚙️ Custom Content - Vanilla Style

Everything is designed to feel like vanilla, just expanded and improved.

### 💰 Economy & Systems

- Rebalanced economy
- Custom coin system
- Adjusted progression and resource values

### 🛠️ Crafting & Mechanics

- Modified crafting recipes
- New mechanics that enhance vanilla gameplay

### ✨ Custom Enchants

Fully custom-coded enchants.

Examples:

- Excavation
- Tree Feller
- Leaf Cutter
- Tree Stripper
- Binding

Additional enchant system:

- Dormant & Awakened enchant system
- Enchants up to Level 20

## 🗺️ Custom World

- Fully custom-made map
- Built for exploration, building, and long-term play
- Unique terrain that feels natural yet fresh

## 🔐 Whitelist System

Livia is whitelist-only to maintain a high-quality and committed playerbase.

✔ No random griefers  
✔ Focus on community quality  
✔ Players who actually want to be here  

## 🚀 Server Status

🟢 Server opened May 1st 2026  
👥 Very active community!
🌍 World progressing quickly

## 💬 Why Join Livia?

- Strong and active community from day one
- Vanilla-friendly but deeper gameplay systems
- Immersive social experience with proximity voice
- Long-term world with real progression

Join the Discord now and be part of something from the beginning.

**Livia is not just a server, it is a world that grows with its players.**
